sources.caption:
🌙✨ Monthly Qutbiyyah Majlis ✨🌙

Assalamualaikum wr wb, our beloved jemaah! 💙🕌

Join us for our Monthly Qutbiyyah Majlis on Sunday, 23rd August 2026 at 9:00 PM in the Main Prayer Hall of Masjid Assyafaah. Let’s gather in remembrance, seeking blessings and praying for our loved ones who have returned to Allah.

🤲 You may contribute sincere donations to include the names of your loved ones in the tahlil. We also welcome sponsorships, with a maximum of 2 slots per session.

📌 Event Details:
📅 Date: Sunday, 23rd August 2026
⏰ Time: 9:00 PM – 10:30 PM
📍 Venue: Masjid Assyafaah, Main Prayer Hall

🔗 Register or contribute here: http://tinyurl.com/ZikirMajlis

May Allah accept our prayers and grant mercy to our departed loved ones. Ameen. See you there, in shaa Allah!
